title: Hoffman's DMT research collaboration with Gallimore

tellings.quote: I'm collaborating with Gallamore on on DMT

plain: Donald Hoffman, a researcher who studies perception and consciousness, says that in 2026 he is working with a neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore on research into DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug. He mentions it on Jesse Michels's podcast, and it matters to his story because some people believe DMT lets users see other realms or beings.
